description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three different language models across various evaluation categories, concluding with an overall average. The horizontal axis displays the categorical evaluation metrics in the following order: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, without an explicit axis label. The chart lacks a traditional vertical value axis with a line, label, or tick marks; instead, the numerical values are represented by the height of the bars and are explicitly annotated above each bar, with values ranging from 0.42 to 1.00. The bars are arranged in groups of three for each category on the horizontal axis. According to the legend positioned below the chart, the dark blue bars represent "RedWhale (our)", the light blue bars represent "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", and the light gray bars represent "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)". Within the groups, the dark blue "RedWhale (our)" bars range from a minimum of 0.42 in the PT-EVAL category to a maximum of 0.71 in the KoBEST-CP category, with an AVG of 0.57. The light blue "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" bars range from 0.46 in PT-EVAL to 0.74 in KoBEST-CP, with an AVG of 0.61. The light gray "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" bars are consistently the tallest across all categories, each annotated with a value of 1.00. The categories on the horizontal axis do not follow a strict ascending or descending numerical sort, though the final category represents an average. Every bar in the chart is visually emphasized with a specific numerical data label placed directly above it.
